kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتعف (form VIII)
# أَرْتَعِفُ (ʔartaʕifu) /ʔar.ta.ʕi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# أُرْتَعَفُ (ʔurtaʕafu) /ʔur.ta.ʕa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# أَرْتَعِفَ (ʔartaʕifa) /ʔar.ta.ʕi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# أُرْتَعَفَ (ʔurtaʕafa) /ʔur.ta.ʕa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
